name: 1-Propanone, 1-(3-bromophenyl)-2-(methylamino)-
summary: 3-Bromomethcathinone (3-BMC) is a stimulant designer drug and monoamine releasing agent of the cathinone family. It acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA), with EC50Tooltip half-maximal effective concentration values for induction of monoamine release of 136–137 nM for serotonin, 25 nM for norepinephrine, and 21–28 nM for dopamine in rat brain synaptosomes.

pharmacology.text: 3-Bromomethcathinone (3-BMC) is a stimulant designer drug and monoamine releasing agent of the cathinone family. It acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA), with EC50 values for induction of monoamine release of 136–137 nM for serotonin, 25 nM for norepinephrine, and 21–28 nM for dopamine in rat brain synaptosomes.

uses.text: 3-Bromomethcathinone (3-BMC) is a stimulant designer drug and monoamine releasing agent of the cathinone family. It emerged as a novel designer drug in Israel and Germany and elsewhere in 2009.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a fast heartbeat, high blood pressure, anxiety, paranoia, overheating and a strong urge to redose.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類的合成卡西酮可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、焦慮、妄想、體溫過高，以及強烈想要追加使用的衝動。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类的合成卡西酮可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、焦虑、妄想、体温过高，以及强烈想要追加使用的冲动。

fact.en: Like mephedrone, it is a methcathinone with an extra group on the ring. Here that group is a bromine atom at the 3 position.
fact.zh: 和喵喵（mephedrone）一樣，它是在苯環上多帶一個取代基的甲卡西酮，只是這裡的取代基是位於3號位置的溴原子。
fact.zhHans: 和喵喵（mephedrone）一样，它是在苯环上多带一个取代基的甲卡西酮，只是这里的取代基是位于3号位置的溴原子。
